name: Cult of Valgavoth
description: Cultists who capture Nashi's rescuers in a ceremonial chamber.

description_citations.text: "Zimone Wola". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: City reveals a tabard with a moth's wings and invites Dawn to join the Cult of Valgavoth, serving the Devouring Father.
timeline.quote: There's still a place for those of us who wish to serve the Devouring Father, among the Cult of Valgavoth.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter warns that they have entered the Valley of Serenity, home of the Cult of Valgavoth; Nashi insists on continuing.
timeline.quote: The Cult of Valgavoth lives here.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter explains the cult's belief and that it captures survivors to convert or feed to Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: They claim Duskmourn was created by an entity summoned by their ancestors

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The party enters a cavern of robed cultists who hold three bound survivors and hang chrysalises.
timeline.quote: Half a dozen humanoid figures in long robes shaped like moth's wings

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A frightened captive accepts the cult's offer and is led toward a chrysalis.
timeline.quote: As a group, they pulled her toward the nearest chrysalis, which was split down the middle, and began to ease her inside.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko leaps onto a stalagmite and challenges the cultists.
timeline.quote: They jumped onto the nearest stalagmite, a shard appearing in either hand.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Cultists seize the Wanderer, Nashi and Niko while Winter bows his head and does not resist.
timeline.quote: Winter only bowed his head, saying nothing, as the cultists rose up and grabbed Niko in turn.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter drops a granite slab that seals the others in with the cultists.
timeline.quote: A slab of solid granite crashed down between him and the others, sealing them in the room with the cultists.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The cult leader's book releases silver dust that knocks the captives unconscious.
timeline.quote: their leader raised his book and blew across the pages, and a thick layer of dust rolled off the paper

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer sees Tamiyo's scroll echo held in a device as a cultist records her stories.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo's scroll echo floated there, flickering in and out of focus, like it hurt her to be manifest.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The cult leader says Valgavoth can now spread to more worlds merely by knowing they exist.
timeline.quote: He no longer needs to strain with all his might to open a door.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The cult leader offers the Wanderer a chance to join them.
timeline.quote: we would be gloriously glad if you would join us

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The head cultist appears and recites the cult's blessing.
timeline.quote: the head cultist walked between them and the Wanderer, still carrying his book.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The head cultist says the captives' knowledge of other worlds will guide the Devouring Father to his next feast.
timeline.quote: Your knowledge will be added to the great list, and with it we will guide the Devouring Father to his next feasting place.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Cultists open a box and Tamiyo's shade appears; Nashi calls to her but she turns away.
timeline.quote: When they put it down, the top snapped open, and Tamiyo's shade appeared.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The head cultist promises Nashi the gift of rebirth in a cocoon.
timeline.quote: His cocoon has been prepared, and he will live eternally in the Devouring Father's service.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth reveals himself as an enormous moth-demon melded into the wall and the cultists kneel.
timeline.quote: what appeared to be an enormous moth spun from the fabric of nightmares

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar bursts in with a brawl, tossing cultists across the room.
timeline.quote: Bad form, to start the battle without us!

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone uses Niv-Mizzet's box to trap a cultist in a cascade of geometric light.
timeline.quote: The box immediately spilled a geometric cascade of blue and green lines into the air.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A cultist stabs Niko through the eye in a fateshifter vision.
timeline.quote: Niko felt the blade pierce their eye and continue through the thin barrier of their skull

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The fateshifter rewinds the moment and Niko dodges and captures the cultist.
timeline.quote: The world snapped like a tightened bowstring, and Niko was looking up at Valgavoth.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Smiling hosts in a hillside house read the reader their holy book, and the reader joins the Cult of Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: You belong to the Cult of Valgavoth now.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter betrays the party to the Cult of Valgavoth, which captures Niko, the Wanderer and Nashi and kills or turns his last friends.
timeline.quote: Niko, the Wanderer, and Nashi were captured after a betrayal by Winter, who sealed them in the room with the cultists.

citation.work: Nashi
citation.text: "Nashi", section "Lost on Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer realizes the cult is siphoning Tamiyo's story echo to feed Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: the cult was using Tamiyo's scroll echo to siphon her stories and feed them to the demon Valgavoth

citation.work: Nashi
citation.text: "Nashi", section "Lost on Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Winter leads the Wanderer and Niko Aris into the Cult's trap; Valgavoth manifests and opens a door to Innistrad for Winter.
timeline.quote: Eventually, Winter led the Wanderer and Niko Aris into a trap set by the Cult.

citation.work: Valgavoth
citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Expansion through Omenpaths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone rescue Nashi, Niko and the Wanderer from the cult and escape through an Omenpath Kaito opens from Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Kaito, who had retreated to Ravnica, used Alquist Proft 's magic to open an artificial Omenpath from Ravnica to Duskmourn

citation.work: Zimone Wola
citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "On Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: City, Rill and Sunset return from a run where Rill was hurt by a Wickerfolk; City reveals he joined the Cult of Valgavoth, betraying the carnival.
timeline.quote: he revealed that He had aligned himself with Duskmourn and joined the Cult of Valgavoth

citation.work: City
citation.text: "City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niko and the Wanderer rescued Nashi from wickerfolk with Winter's help, but Winter betrayed them to the cult.
timeline.quote: before betraying them to the Cult of Valgavoth to fulfill his bargain with the demon

citation.work: Duskmourn Rescue Mission
citation.text: "Duskmourn Rescue Mission", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone reunited with and freed Nashi, Niko and the Wanderer, and learned the cult siphoned Tamiyo's stories to empower Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: Tyvar and Zimone reunited with and freed Nashi, Niko, and the Wanderer.

citation.work: Duskmourn Rescue Mission
citation.text: "Duskmourn Rescue Mission", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
